[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > < deviceB | ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > < deviceB | ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < cloudA | 'key' : 'secret' , deviceB : ('trusted' : (UserX)) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ UserX 'shareAccess' cloudA | (deviceB ; UserY)
=> < cloudA | 'key' : 'secret' , deviceB : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY)) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ cloudA 'proxyCommand' RelayUser | (deviceB ; encrypt('auth','secret') ; 'share' ; UserY) .
[B4] < cloudA | 'key' : 'secret' , deviceB : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY)) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' cloudA | (deviceB ; UserY)
=> < cloudA | 'key' : 'secret' , deviceB : ('trusted' : (UserX)) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ cloudA 'proxyCommand' RelayUser | (deviceB ; encrypt('auth','secret') ; 'revoke' ; UserY) .
[B5] < RelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , ... > < ImmediateRelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ RelayUser 'forwardCommand' deviceB | (L)
=> < RelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , ... > < ImmediateRelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ RelayUser 'proxyCommand' deviceB | L .
[B6] < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , 'cachedCommand' : nils , ... > $ cloudA 'proxyCommand' CachingRelayUser | (deviceB ; L)
=> < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , 'cachedCommand' : L , ... > .
[B7] < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , 'cachedCommand' : L , ... >
=> < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : deviceB , 'cachedCommand' : nils , ... > $ CachingRelayUser 'proxyCommand' deviceB | L .
[B8] < deviceB | 'trusted' : TrustedUsers , ... > $ RelayUser 'proxyCommand' deviceB | (deviceB ; encrypt('auth','secret') ; 'share' ; UserY)
=> < deviceB | 'trusted' : (TrustedUsers , UserY) , ... > .
[B9] < deviceB | 'trusted' : (TrustedUsers , UserY) , ... > $ RelayUser 'proxyCommand' deviceB | (deviceB ; encrypt('auth','secret') ; 'revoke' ; UserY)
=> < deviceB | 'trusted' : TrustedUsers , ... > .
